metas.name: 2026 · President Curtis
metas.description: Follows President Andre Curtis and his eccentric staff as they deal with various crises that Rick Sanchez typically ignores.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
metas.description: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom, from The Big Bang Theory (2007), returns in a new series where he attempts—and apparently fails—to save the universe, staying true to his unlucky nature.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Ann Droid
metas.description: Ann, an advanced AI, grapples with human emotions while discovering dark secrets within the corporation that created her.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · The Ghost in the Shell
metas.description: In the year 2029, Niihama City has become a technologically advanced metropolis. Due to great improvements in cybernetics, its citizens are able to replace their limbs with robotic parts.

metas.name: 2026 · Star City
metas.description: Soviet cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers risk everything in an ambitious space program aiming to be the first to reach the moon.
